name: ALVINN
summary: Dean Pomerleau trained a three-layer network to map 30x32 camera images to steering direction, driving a vehicle on public roads. Every modern end-to-end policy descends from this, as does the field's oldest known failure mode: covariate shift, which Pomerleau already patched by synthetically generating off-center views, the ancestor of today's augmentation and DAgger.
innovation: End-to-end learning from raw sensor input to control, with no hand-designed perception stack.
Synthetic view generation to cover states the human demonstrator never visited.
matters: Defines behavior cloning, the substrate under every VLA on this map.
limits: Tiny capacity, no language, no generalization beyond the demonstrated conditions.
lineage: The root of the imitation-learning branch.
